news.title: Taapsee Pannu Flaunts Retro Fashion in Latest Photoshoot
news.summary: Taapsee Pannu showcased a bold retro glam look in her recent photoshoot featuring voluminous curls, a floral mini dress, sheer stockings, and gold heels against vintage backdrops. Despite facing underperforming box-office outings in 2026 with Advocate Raavi and Gandhari, the actor continues filming for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan? where she plays ACP Komal Sharma. Her career has been marked by candid reflections on overcoming past industry hurdles and selecting roles on her own terms.

news.title: Sambarala Yeti Gattu Sticks Firmly to Its Sankranti Release Schedule
news.summary: Makers of the mass action entertainer Sambarala Yeti Gattu have confirmed that the film will maintain its scheduled release date of January 12, 2027, for Sankranti, despite overlapping announcements. Starring Sai Durga Tej and directed by newcomer Rohith KP, the project is currently in its final stages of post-production according to producer Chaitanya Reddy. Speculation had risen about potential schedule shifts after Chiranjeevi's Kaaka announced a January 13 release, but the team is locked into the festival race.

news.title: Hombale Films Acquires Southern Rights for Hit Hindi Feature Hanuman Ansh
news.summary: Following a massive box office run in the Hindi belt approaching Rs. 300 crores, the low-budget biographical drama Hanuman Ansh is heading to southern markets. Hombale Films has secured the southern dubbing rights to distribute the movie in various regional languages after initial plans by director Trivikram Srinivas did not materialize. Directed by Vishal Chaturvedi and based on his book Divine Detour: That Changed My Life, the film chronicles the early journey of Neem Karoli Baba.

news.title: NTR Prepares to Join Dragon Set in Mumbai
news.summary: Star actor NTR is gearing up to return to the film sets after recovering from a shoulder break. Director Prashanth Neel has kept filming moving with other portions while waiting for the star to rejoin. An extensive two-week action schedule is set to kick off in Mumbai starting October 10th.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi Nears Completion of January 12 Vidudala
news.summary: Filmmaker Anil Ravipudi is racing through his production schedule for January 12 Vidudala without facing delays. The unit is heading to Ooty for their upcoming schedule in early October, followed by overseas song shoots. The entire filming process is slated for completion by mid-November, leaving ample time for post-production ahead of the January release.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Steady Momentum on Third Day
news.summary: Nani's latest cinematic outing, The Paradise, has opened to record-shattering responses and remarkable box-office momentum. The film maintained solid collections on its third day, drawing massive crowds of family audiences to theatres over the holiday weekend. This strong theatrical run highlights the actor's immense star power and audience appeal.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Unveils a Twist-Filled Romantic Drama
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has officially debuted in Hyderabad, setting high expectations for a fresh musical entertainer. The plot follows a carefree young man whose world turns upside down when his love interest mysteriously vanishes. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the movie is scheduled to arrive in cinemas worldwide on October 9th.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled for Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of the much-awaited epic Ramayana have released new visuals featuring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman against a scenic backdrop. Additionally, the first look of Yash as the formidable antagonist Ravana has been revealed, showcasing his royal attire and striking presence. Part 1 of the ambitious project is slated for a Diwali 2026 release, followed by Part 2 in Diwali 2027.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Blends Youthful Romance With Mysterious Thrills
news.summary: Aakash Jagannadh recently launched the theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird in Hyderabad ahead of its worldwide release on October 9. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the film starts as a lighthearted romantic journey before taking a dark turn when the female lead mysteriously disappears. The movie features Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal in lead roles, backed by a compelling background score from Prince Henry.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Keeps Momentum Going Strong at the Box Office
news.summary: Despite opening to mixed critical reviews following an early midweek release, Nani's The Paradise has crossed a worldwide gross of 136 crore in its first three days. The film witnessed a notable surge in collections across the Telugu states and is performing well in overseas markets like the UK and Australia. The core team recently celebrated this success at an event alongside actor Mohan Babu.

news.title: NTR Set to Resume Shoot for Prashanth Neel's Dragon Next Month
news.summary: Actor NTR is gearing up to return to film sets following his recovery from a shoulder injury and subsequent surgery. He will join a 15-day action-heavy schedule for Prashanth Neel's directorial Dragon in Mumbai starting October 10 alongside Anil Kapoor. Produced by Mythri Movie Makers with Rukmini Vasanth as the female lead, the pan-India project is currently eyeing a theatrical release in June 2027.

news.title: Nani’s The Paradise Faces Crucial Monday Box Office Test
news.summary: Nani's big-budget film The Paradise has encountered mixed reactions from audiences and critics despite a strong opening weekend. Trade reports estimate the movie collected around ₹120 crore gross by Saturday and aims for a ₹220 crore target. With no major competitors releasing next week, Monday's performance will be vital in determining its final theatrical run and recovery.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled for Upcoming Epic Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of the pan-Indian mythological adaptation Ramayana have released two distinct character posters ahead of its Diwali release parts in 2026 and 2027. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the visuals feature Yash in a regal and wealthy avatar as Ravana alongside a serene trio poster of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. The project features music scored by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer.

news.title: Nagarjuna's Milestone Film King100 Plans Special Teaser for Tabu
news.summary: Nagarjuna Akkineni's landmark project King100 is set to unveil a special character teaser introducing Tabu's role in the film. The movie brings back the hit 90s pairing alongside other lead cast members like Sushmita Bhat. Directed by Ra Karthik with music by Devi Sri Prasad, the feature is scheduled to hit theaters on December 24, 2026.

news.title: Makers of Vijay Deverakonda's Ranabaali Announce Four-Part Promotional Docu-Series
news.summary: Ranabaali, directed by Rahul Sankrityan and starring Vijay Deverakonda, is gearing up for its theatrical release on October 16, 2026. To promote the historical drama based on British suppression in Rayalaseema, the team is launching a four-part documentary series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. The project highlights two years of historical research and features insights from the lead cast and director.

news.title: The Paradise Maintains Steady Box Office Pace in Nizam on Day 3
news.summary: The Nani-starrer The Paradise continued its stable box office run in the Nizam region on its third day. The action drama directed by Srikanth Odela brought in a share of roughly Rs. 5 crore, pushing its overall theatrical share closer to the Rs. 23 crore mark.

news.title: BRS Leader KTR Applauds Nani Starrer The Paradise After Hyderabad Screening
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR watched the Nani-starrer The Paradise at Sudarshan Theatre in Hyderabad. He praised the film for capturing Telangana's culture and effectively portraying the struggles of an oppressed community.

news.title: Industry Reports Highlight Rashmika Mandanna's Strong OTT Market Valuation
news.summary: Industry circles indicate that leading streaming platforms command higher valuations for female-centric projects headlined by Rashmika Mandanna compared to Sai Pallavi. Rashmika's involvement in several pan-Indian blockbusters and her substantial social media audience are cited as key contributors to this market standing.

news.title: The Paradise Keeps Up Ticket Sales Momentum on BookMyShow
news.summary: Despite facing mixed audience talk, the Nani-starrer The Paradise sustained solid ticket booking trends on BookMyShow during its third day. The project crossed Rs. 115 crore in gross earnings over its first two days and registered 252K ticket sales on day three.

news.title: Shocking Exit in Bigg Boss Telugu 10 as Contestant Grabs Cash Prize
news.summary: In a stunning development on Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, wildcard entrant Mithilesh chose to exit the reality show after just 24 hours. He decided to take home a temptation offer of 15 lakh rupees, reasoning that house dynamics would prevent him from claiming the title. This marks a completely unprecedented early departure in the history of the television program.

news.title: Nani Expresses Joy Over The Paradise Box Office Momentum
news.summary: Actor Nani addressed the media in Hyderabad during a promotional event for his latest movie, The Paradise. He highlighted how audience sentiment remarkably shifted from negative to positive as screenings progressed. Nani credited the entire cast, crew, and technicians for their relentless dedication to the project.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Role in The Paradise His Deadliest Yet
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu spoke at the Hyderabad press meet for The Paradise, directed by Srikanth Odela. The seasoned star revealed that his character in the film is the most ferocious role he has taken on across his fifty-year career. He also praised director Srikanth Odela's vision and actor Nani's tremendous hard work.

news.title: Natural Star Nani Highlights Unique Audience Turnaround for The Paradise
news.summary: During a recent media interaction in Hyderabad, actor Nani discussed the unusual audience trajectory of his latest release, The Paradise. Unlike films that start strong and fade, he noted that public reception for his movie steadily improved with every single screening. The Srikanth Odela directorial features a prominent ensemble cast including Mohan Babu and Raghav Juyal.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled for Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana
news.summary: The much-awaited mythological epic Ramayana has unveiled striking new character posters featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey, and Yash. Helmed by director Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, the grand visual spectacle includes visual effects by DNEG. The film is slated for a worldwide theatrical release in IMAX format during Diwali 2026, with global distribution managed by Sony Pictures International.
